title: Condorcet probability for odd majority
statement: For an electorate of size $2k+1$ with independent uniformly distributed rankings of three candidates, the probability that majority rule yields a Condorcet winner converges, as $k\to\infty$, to $\frac{3}{2\pi}\arccos(-\frac13)$.
